CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 8, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:57 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Corona, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger;
  Stanley Tsai, Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – August 25, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the August 25, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the August 25, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-019
  • 431 North Hidalgo Avenue
  • Applicant: Ana Derby
  • Request: This is an application for the partial demolition of the
  existing first-floor roof, exterior alterations to the existing second-floor
  granny flat, construction of a new interior stair connection between
  1
  09/08/2026
   the second floor and the main house, modifications to the existing
  first-floor patio windows and doors, and construction of a new 638 SF
  second-floor addition to an existing 2-story single-family residence.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the proposed Colored Elevations to correct the
  graphical discrepancy and accurately depict the existing
  rounded gable vents on the residence.
  2. Provide a decorative grille element over the existing rounded
  gable vent on the East Elevation to match the proposed grille
  for the new rounded window on the second-floor addition.
  3. Provide additional articulation along the east-facing surface of
  the proposed new chimney stack, which shall be compatible
  with the existing Spanish architectural character of the
  residence.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:15 P.M. to
  Tuesday, September 22, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Corona
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
